name: What happens if a minor repair uncovers hidden water damage or rot?

mainEntity.name: What happens if a minor repair uncovers hidden water damage or rot?

acceptedAnswer.text: If a minor repair exposes mold, active water leaks, or compromised framing studs, we pause work immediately to review the findings with you. Because HH Remodeling manages full-scope renovations and storm restoration, we can address the underlying source instead of simply covering it up. Abraham can coordinate necessary plumbing repairs, replace rotted framing or subflooring, and treat the affected area before completing the final drywall, tile, or paint finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: We pause to show you the damage, explain your options, and repair the underlying structural or moisture problem before completing the visible cosmetic fix.
